main_question: Can tagged gate attendance predict next-year nest scan, first-ever verified egg, or old-micro-patch site choice? Distinguish these as separate estimands.

AAS_4086_gate.sampling_unit: shared gateway used by several subcolonies on one Béchervaise Island

published_fields: age first return/first nesting derived fields
field_limits: same gate tag code not confirmed
direct first-own-egg date not confirmed at individual level
nest micro-patch position of prior gate visitor absent

prior_art_vetoes: Emmerson, Walsh and Southwell 2019 doi:10.1002/ece3.5067 already coupled same-season individual gate records to on-nest breeder or nonbreeder and directly watched eggs in a subset.
Emmerson and Southwell 2022 GCB doi:10.1111/gcb.16437 and AAS_4518 dataset already analyzed recruitment including derived Age first.nesting.all.6.years; generic first breeding age is not new.
Penney 1970 doi:10.1016/0003-3472(70)90048-5 already reports 58% of first-breeding young had previously visited vicinity of future nest.
Acker et al 2022 doi:10.1111/1365-2656.13676 already tests competition for high-quality colony sites on breeding propensity.

source_classification.gate_first_pass: FIRST DETECTED PASS at shared gate, not true first colony arrival or a visited nest location
source_classification.tag_on_nest: OBSERVED NEST ATTENDANCE, not confirmed own egg
source_classification.tag_not_found_at_nest: UNKNOWN state with scanner detection failure/absence/confounding, not confirmed nonbreeding
source_classification.known_first_egg: requires independently linked direct egg + individual natal and prior reproduction history
source_classification.micro_patch_prospecting: NOT LOCATED by a common gate entrance serving more than one breeding subcolony
source_classification.island_dispersal: NOT SAMPLED across distinct islands by the same two main source datasets

estimands.scope: conditional next-year apparent attendance on nest among individually gate-detected and observed birds, not a true first-breeding probability
conditional first-ever egg attempt after prior gate visit; not automatic evidence of inter-island recruitment
does the same marked penguin use an actual particular earlier visited nest neighborhood?
estimands.structural_reason: the published weighbridge measures the path for several subcolonies, not the specific nest patch that bird inspected

estimands.scope: inter-island causal recipient settlement or recruitment from earlier prospecting
